faction.yandi-town.yandi.description:
{Yandi}
Faction Alignment: Good, Order
Native Terrain: Grass
Location: Jadam Continent - Volcanic Zone
After the 1170-year silence following the restoration war on the Enroth continent, various powers reshuffled, and Jadam, as one of the three major continents of the planet Enroth (Colony Star), was being infiltrated by undead forces. The local mage clans, seeking to strengthen their combat power against the increasingly rampant undead legions near the Shadow Spiral Mountains, attempted to summon the legendary fire power from the elemental plane through a portal. Although the mages of Jadam were skilled in spatial magic at the time, they still had flaws in controlling the stability of the dimensional passage. During a high-level ritual that gathered the power of the entire clan, the magical array's energy suddenly went out of control, and the coordinates of the dimensional portal severely shifted. Instead of connecting to the elemental plane, it tore open a spatial-temporal rift to the ancient Chinese mythological plane. At that time, shortly after the Battle of Zhuolu, the Yandi tribe, having just endured a brutal battle with the Chiyou tribe and facing difficulties during their migration, had their settlement spatially overlap with this rift. The entire resting Yandi tribe, along with their altars and farming facilities, were drawn into the rift and eventually fell into the volcanic plain of southern Jadam. Upon first arriving in Jadam, the Yandi people fell into brief chaos. The unfamiliar climate, strange magical beasts, and energy-disturbed land made it difficult for them, accustomed to the Central Plains farming environment, to advance. However, the Yandi tribe inherited the resilience and wisdom of Shennong. Their leader (a descendant of Yandi who inherited the title and legacy of Yandi) quickly stabilized the tribe. They discovered that although the environment of this volcanic plain was harsh, the soil was exceptionally fertile due to volcanic ash, and the underground contained abundant fire energy, which perfectly matched the tribe's traditional skills of flame farming and herbal cultivation. Meanwhile, the local indigenous tribes, plagued by both undead and magical beasts, saw that the Yandi people could use fire magic to improve the land, grow high-yield grains, and heal diseases with herbs, and so they actively sought an alliance. The Yandi tribe accepted the indigenous tribes with benevolence, teaching them farming techniques and medical knowledge while integrating indigenous magical beast taming skills, gradually establishing themselves on this land. Using their ancient altar as the core, they built a city combining Chinese architectural style with Jadam's regional characteristics. Because the tribe always remembered Yandi's protection, they named it Yandi. The city's buildings are mainly made of fire-resistant stone, with walls carved with Yandi mythological totems such as farming and tasting herbs. The flame altar in the core area serves to maintain the connection between the tribe and the fire energy of this continent. The rise of Yandi quickly attracted the attention of surrounding powers. The dark mages and remaining undead forces of Jadam, fearing the undead-suppressing effect of their fire power, began plotting attacks in secret. More unexpectedly, the dimensional portal's instability not only brought the Yandi tribe but also a small remnant of Chiyou's tribe through the spatial-temporal fragments. This remnant settled in the dark canyons of Jadam, absorbed the local dark energy, and became increasingly fierce. Their leader always harbored an obsession with the Yandi tribe, determined to complete the ancient unfinished conquest. When the dark mages and the Chiyou remnant formed an alliance, a conflict mirroring the ancient Battle of Zhuolu erupted. The Chiyou remnant launched fierce attacks using weapons and witchcraft infused with dark energy, while the dark mages used curse magic to weaken Yandi's defenses. At this critical moment, the leader of Yandi, following the example of their ancestors' strategy of allying with allies, contacted the indigenous tribes they had helped and also reached out to the Jadam mage clan who had caused the dimensional rift. The mages, wanting to make amends, sent elites to help reinforce the city's magical defenses and taught the Yandi people how to enhance their fire magic using Jadam's energy system. In the end, with the help of the allied forces, the Yandi tribe fought a decisive battle against the Chiyou remnant and dark mages on the volcanic plain. On the battlefield, the warriors of Yandi wielded fire magic, recreating the scene of breaking enemies with flames from ancient wars while incorporating Jadam's magical techniques to form a unique offensive and defensive system. The priests on the altar treated the wounded with a combination of herbs and magic, continuing Shennong's healing heritage. The battle ended with the defeat of the Chiyou remnant and the expulsion of the dark mages. After the battle, Yandi became an important power in southern Jadam. It was no longer an isolated tribal fortress but a hub blending Chinese farming civilization with Jadam's magical civilization. The Yandi people hybridized plants from the Colony Star with native crops, cultivating new species adaptable to multiple environments. Their fire magic was also adopted by Jadam mages to improve the stability technology of dimensional passages. The legend of Yandi gradually spread across Jadam Continent, becoming a timeless story in Colonial history: an ancient tribe from another dimension used benevolence and wisdom to overcome crises, turning a foreign land into their home, adding a magnificent chapter to the continent's civilization. Later, when Escaton attempted to destroy the planet in 1172 S.D., Yandi's fire power assisted the heroes of Jadam in freeing the elemental lords and preventing the world's destruction.
faction.yandi-town.yandi.name: Yandi
hero.yandi-town.yandieadrian.biography: A direct descendant of Yandi Shennong, and the tribal leader who succeeded after the Battle of Zhuolu. When the dimensional portal went awry, he was leading the tribe to rest during their migration. In the critical moment, he used his spiritual power to protect the core altar, allowing the tribe to fully cross the spatial-temporal rift. Upon arriving at the Jadam volcanic plain, he overcame opposition to accept the indigenous tribes, using the benevolent way of his ancestors 'tasting herbs and teaching farming' to unite the people, and presided over the construction of Yandi. He is proficient in ancient fire witchcraft and farming rituals, able to communicate with the fire energy of the Jadam continent through the flame altar, both to enhance the combat power of his people and to promote crop growth. In the decisive battle against the Chiyou remnant and dark mages, he used the altar as the core to set up a flame barrier, resisting the erosion of dark curses. He is the undeniable spiritual pillar of Yandi.
hero.yandi-town.yandieadrian.name: Yan Zhuo
hero.yandi-town.yandieadrian.specialty.d: The hero's army takes reduced damage from Armorer based on hero level. All troops gain +1 health, +4% health, and the hero gains +2 Defense.
hero.yandi-town.yandiedalia.biography: Born from the Xuan Stone People tribe of the ancient Chinese 'Remnant Range of Buzhou Mountain'. Grateful that the Yandi ancestors used spiritual herbs to cure a plague in the stone people tribe, they followed the Yandi tribe for generations, becoming the tribe's most reliable 'mobile fortress'. His body is forged from thousand-year Xuan Iron Bedrock, possessing immense strength, invulnerability to weapons, and the ability to manipulate stone energy to construct defensive barriers. When crossing through time and space, he used his massive body to protect the tribe's core food supplies and craftsman tools, withstanding the impact of the temporal currents — even when his bedrock body was cracked, he did not move an inch. Upon arriving in Jadam, he took on the responsibility of building Yandi's defensive fortifications: quarrying volcanic fire-resistant stones, reinforcing city walls, and laying stone traps. The north gate, where he stood guard for years, became known as the 'Bedrock Barrier', and the enemy's multiple probing attacks were easily repelled by him. He is skilled in using stone energy, able to grant his 'Xuan Iron Stone Skin' trait to his soldiers, making the Rock Shield Legion an 'impregnable fortress'. In the decisive battle, he personally guarded the north gate, activating the city wall's stone barrier with the 'Bedrock Prison Suppression Art', withstanding multiple waves of attacks from the Chiyou remnant. Even when surrounded by several dark magical beasts, he did not retreat a single step. The troops under his command never broke even when surrounded, becoming the backbone of the allied forces' defense.
hero.yandi-town.yandiedalia.name: Qi An
hero.yandi-town.yandiedalia.specialty.de: Negates natural spell immunities on the battlefield and increases Magic Resistance by 10% per hero level.
hero.yandi-town.yandiedecken.biography: A descendant of the ancient Red Dragon Clan. Tired of the internal conflicts within the dragon clan, he voluntarily followed the Yandi tribe during their migration, becoming Yan Hao's most trusted combat pillar. When crossing through time and space, he transformed into human form to guard the flank of the altar. When attacked by lava monsters in the temporal currents, he revealed his dragon form and incinerated several monsters with his crimson flame dragon breath, carving out a path for the tribe. After settling in Jadam, he formed the 'Dragon Flame Guard', teaching the tribe dragon clan combat techniques and using his own dragon energy to nourish the fire energy of the volcanic plain, doubling the power of Yandi's flame magic. He was utterly loyal to Yan Hao, considering it his duty to protect Yandi. In the decisive battle, he again revealed his dragon form, engaging in direct combat with the dark magical beast leader of the Chiyou remnant. His crimson flame dragon breath not only burned a large number of undead troops but also broke the dark mages' dark shields, laying a key foundation for the allied forces' victory.
hero.yandi-town.yandiedecken.name: Chi Yuan
hero.yandi-town.yandiedecken.specialty.d: Increases the chance that wandering creatures will join the hero and grants the hero a 50% surrender discount.
hero.yandi-town.yandiefadland.biography: Originally the chieftain of an indigenous tribe on the Jadam volcanic plain, his tribe had long been plagued by undead and magical beasts and was on the verge of extinction. After the Yandi tribe arrived, Yan Hao used farming techniques and herbs to help his people. Deeply moved, Man Shi voluntarily led his tribe to join them. He was familiar with the terrain of the Jadam continent and the habits of magical beasts, combining the indigenous heavy defense tactics with Yandi tribe battle formations to form the 'Rock Shield Legion'. Possessing immense strength, he could lift hundreds of pounds of fire-resistant stone. During the construction of Yandi, he led his people to quarry stone and reinforce the city walls, becoming the main builder of the city's defense system. When the Chiyou remnant attacked the city, he personally guarded the north gate. With the tight defense of his heavy infantry, he withstood multiple waves of enemy attacks. The north gate thus became known as the 'Man Shi Barrier'. He was utterly loyal to Yandi and was an important symbol of tribal integration.
hero.yandi-town.yandiefadland.name: Man Shi
Increases melee damage from Offense based on hero level. All troops gain +2 damage and +2 Morale.
hero.yandi-town.yandiehilika.biography: A forestry and animal husbandry expert of the Yandi tribe, skilled in tree planting and livestock domestication. After crossing through time and space, he discovered that Jadam's forests were rich in resources, but some trees were toxic and unsuitable for direct use. He led his team to clear the toxic trees and plant fast-growing Chinese forests, which not only met the timber needs for city construction but also improved the surrounding ecological environment. In animal husbandry, he hybridized Chinese livestock with native Jadam magical beasts, cultivating livestock varieties that combined docility and high yield. The hybrid 'Yan Oxen' not only produced delicious meat but also helped with farming. The 'Fire Feather Chickens' laid eggs with flame energy, which became an important source of energy for mages. He also drew on the indigenous magical beast taming techniques to train some combat-capable magical beasts (such as flame lizards), which became a special fighting force for Yandi.
hero.yandi-town.yandiehilika.name: Chi Yao
hero.yandi-town.yandiehilika.specialty.d: Yandi creatures take 20% less damage from ranged attacks.
hero.yandi-town.yandieiser.biography: An ancient witchcraft priest of the Yandi tribe, inheriting Shennong's witchcraft secrets, skilled in countering dark curses and applying buffs. Her witchcraft differs from mage magic, focusing more on communication with natural energy, and has a natural countering effect against dark energy. When crossing through time and space, she used her witchcraft to protect the tribe's core texts, preventing them from being destroyed by the temporal currents. When fighting against dark mages, her 'Curse Resistance' witchcraft became an important safeguard for the allied forces, effectively resisting the curse erosion of dark mages. Her 'Weakness Curse' could weaken the combat power of the Chiyou remnant warriors, giving the allied forces an advantage in melee combat. She could also communicate with Jadam's nature spirits through witchcraft, gaining protection from forests and mountains — during reconnaissance, the nature spirits would guide her direction and help avoid danger. She is the core of Yandi's witchcraft heritage and an important force in resisting dark powers.
hero.yandi-town.yandieiser.name: Yu Ning
hero.yandi-town.yandieiser.specialty.des: Summons Brute Frogs as guardians. Brute Frogs and their upgrades gain +10 health, +1 Speed, First Strike, and cast Cure as enchanters.
hero.yandi-town.yandiejacquenas.biograph: An heir of the Yandi tribe's archery family, skilled in making arrows enhanced with witchcraft. Before the crossing, he had achieved the feat of 'a hundred paces to hit a willow, three arrows in a row'. Upon arriving in Jadam, flying magical beasts often harassed the tribe's settlement on the volcanic plain. He led archer units to build 'Fire Watchtowers', killing the beasts with 'Flame Arrows' infused with volcanic sulfur and herbs, solving the tribe's urgent problems. He discovered that Jadam's 'Iron Grain Wood' was extremely hard, so he collaborated with craftsmen to improve the bow's design, creating the 'Black Iron Bow', with range and penetration far exceeding traditional bows. He also borrowed the mages' 'enchantment techniques' to add an 'armor-piercing' effect to his arrows, capable of penetrating the dark mages' magic shields. In the decisive battle, he led the Forest Guard to occupy high ground, accurately shooting dark mages in the back rows with his 'Ironbow' to prevent them from casting large-scale curse magic. His archer unit became known as the 'Eagle Eye of Yandi'.
hero.yandi-town.yandiejacquenas.name: Xuan Ge
hero.yandi-town.yandiejacquenas.specialt: Yandi creatures gain +1 Speed, suffer no range or melee penalty, and ranged attacks deal extra damage from Archery based on hero level.
hero.yandi-town.yandiejoseph.biography: A farming expert of the Yandi tribe, whose ancestors were core members who followed Shennong in tasting a hundred herbs and teaching farming techniques. He has a high sensitivity to soil and climate, able to accurately determine the suitable environment for different crops. After crossing to Jadam, he discovered that although the soil of the volcanic plain was fertile, the dry climate and large temperature difference between day and night made it difficult for Chinese crops to adapt. He led the farming team through repeated experiments, hybridizing Chinese grain seeds with native Jadam plants to develop new crops such as 'Yan Grain' and 'Fire Wheat' that combined high yield and drought resistance. He also drew on Mochen's earth magic to improve soil structure through magical means, enhancing the crops' resistance to pests and diseases. In the early days of Yandi, it was the high-yield crops he cultivated that solved the food crisis for the tribe and the indigenous people, laying the material foundation for the subsequent rise of their power. He also taught farming techniques to the indigenous tribes, promoting the integration of the two peoples.
hero.yandi-town.yandiejoseph.name: Baicao Xun
hero.yandi-town.yandiejoseph.specialty.d: All troops gain +1 Speed. Good creatures gain +1 Morale, neutral creatures gain +1 Luck, and the hero's troops cast Bless as enchanters.
hero.yandi-town.yandiemadan.biography: His ancestors were commanders of the 'Fire Guards' who charged into battle for Yandi during the Battle of Zhuolu, and he was born with a strong affinity for fire. When crossing through time and space, he was leading the guard to protect the tribe's flank when they were attacked by lava monsters drawn into the rift. Wielding his ancestral bronze sword, he ignited the blade with his spiritual power and slew three monsters, carving out a path to survival. After settling in Jadam, he integrated the indigenous 'magical beast taming' techniques with the Chinese 'Fish Scale Formation' tactics to form the 'Flame Blade Legion'. He discovered that Jadam's sulfur ore could enhance flame power, so he had craftsmen incorporate it into weapon forging, creating exclusive weapons like the 'Crimson Flame Blade' and 'Fire Wind Lance'. In the decisive battle, he led the Flame Blade Legion to break through the Chiyou remnant's 'Black Armor Formation', striking directly at the Chiyou remnant leader with his flame longsword. Although he didn't succeed, he successfully disrupted the enemy's deployment. His 'Flame Blade' terrified the undead troops — the fire's burning damage to undead could directly dismantle their regeneration ability.
hero.yandi-town.yandiemadan.name: Sui Ming
hero.yandi-town.yandiemadan.specialty.de: Yandi creatures receive Prayer and Cure as special enchantments, gain stronger Stone Skin based on hero level, +5 health, and healing ability.
hero.yandi-town.yandiemarcus.biography: The 38th generation direct descendant of Yandi Shennong, who studied the 'Shennong Flame Canon' from a young age. He possessed both the flame spirit power of ancient rituals and the strategic vision of a great leader, making him the core leader of the tribe during their dimensional crossing. On the night the dimensional portal went out of control, he was presiding over the 'Flame Pivot Heaven Sacrifice' ceremony. Sensing the dark energy erupting from the spatial-temporal rift, he used his own blood essence to activate the core of the altar, the 'Shennong Fire Seed', protecting the tribe's core fighting forces, farming texts, and medical treasures. After surviving countless perils, he arrived at the Jadam volcanic plain. Upon arriving in this strange land, facing the tribe's panic and the hostility of indigenous tribes, he followed his ancestors' way of 'uniting the lords and comforting the people'. He used high-yield grains to save the starving indigenous people, personally led guards to eliminate magma monsters harassing the tribe, and ultimately brokered an alliance between the Yandi tribe and three indigenous tribes. He personally drew the blueprints and supervised the construction of Yandi, combining Chinese rammed earth techniques with Jadam's fire-resistant magical stones. The city walls were carved with totems of 'Shennong Tasting Herbs' and 'Zhuolu Breaking Chiyou'. The 'Flame Pivot War Drum' stood at the city gate, becoming both a spiritual and defensive pillar for the tribe. In the decisive battle against the Chiyou remnant, he donned the ancestral 'Heaven Burning Armor', wielded the 'Flame Pivot Halberd', and used the 'Flame Pivot' to channel the volcanic earth's flame energy, setting up the 'Heaven Burning Barrier'. He withstood the dark mages' 'Undead Plague' and personally led the core forces in the charge, making him the unshakable spiritual and combat center of Yandi.
hero.yandi-town.yandiemarcus.name: Yan Cang
hero.yandi-town.yandiemarcus.specialty.d: Dragon-nature creatures gain +10% Magic Resistance, regenerate 50 health, and attack with wide breath.
hero.yandi-town.yandierogue.biography: A priest of the Yandi tribe, who studied ancient fire magic and ritual ceremonies from a young age, able to communicate with the flame energy in nature. When crossing through time and space, he was conducting a farming ritual, and the flame energy of the altar protected him and the priests around him. Upon arriving in Jadam, he discovered that the fire energy here was more violent than in the ancient Chinese mythological plane, so he began to integrate the magical systems of Jadam mages and improve his own magical techniques. His 'Flame Domain Barrier' could both defend against enemy attacks and grant flame buffs to allies. His 'Wall of Fire' spell could not only block enemy advances but also burn undead and dark creatures that stepped into it. In battles against dark mages, he used pure fire magic to counter dark curses, successfully breaking their 'Animate Dead' spells, demonstrating powerful magical suppression. He was also a mentor to the young mages of Yandi, responsible for passing on the integrated fire magic techniques.
hero.yandi-town.yandierogue.name: Kun Yao
hero.yandi-town.yandierogue.specialty.de: Increases mana gained from Intelligence by 10% per hero level and reduces allied spell costs by 2 spell points.
hero.yandi-town.yandiesean.biography: A healer of the Yandi tribe, proficient in herbal medicine and water witchcraft, and one of the core figures of Shennong's medical legacy. When crossing through time and space, she carried a large number of herbal seeds and medical texts, which became an important resource for treating the wounded and coping with the unfamiliar environment in the early days of Yandi. Upon arriving in Jadam, many tribe members fell ill due to environmental discomfort. During the day, she led healers to gather native herbs, and at night she consulted texts, attempting to combine native herbs with Chinese herbs to develop various effective remedies. Her water healing magic could not only treat physical wounds but also purify the erosion caused by dark energy. When countering the dark mages' curses, her 'Cleansing' spell became a lifeline for the allied forces, as countless soldiers cursed by dark energy regained their combat ability under her treatment. She also established a medical academy in Yandi, teaching medical knowledge to both the tribe and the indigenous people, earning the respect of all.
hero.yandi-town.yandiesean.name: Yun Xi
hero.yandi-town.yandiesean.specialty.des: Generates 500 gold per day and increases experience gained from Learning by 10% per hero level.
hero.yandi-town.yandiesuleiman.biography: A direct descendant of the ancient Red Dragon Clan. Dissatisfied with the dragon clan's philosophy of 'hiding and seeking comfort', he voluntarily took the dragon clan treasure 'Burning Flame Scale Armor' and followed the Yandi tribe, becoming Yan Chen's most trusted 'wall-breaking blade'. When crossing through time and space, he transformed into human form to guard the flank of the Flame Pivot Altar. When surrounded by several abyssal lava monsters in the temporal currents, he revealed his 30-zhang (approx. 100 meters) red dragon true form at the critical moment, incinerating the monsters with Heaven Burning Crimson Flame Dragon Breath, opening a safe passage for the tribe's migration. After settling in Jadam, he used dragon clan secret arts to form the 'Dragon Flame Guard' — selecting elite warriors from the tribe and tempering their combat power with his own dragon energy. He also used the Red Dragon Clan's flame energy to nourish the fire energy nodes of the volcanic plain, doubling the power of Yandi's flame magic. He was utterly loyal to Yan Chen, considering it his dragon clan mission to protect the flame seed of Yandi. In the decisive battle, he again revealed his red dragon true form, engaging in direct combat with the dark magical beast leader 'Erosion Bone Demon Serpent' raised by the Chiyou remnant. His crimson flame dragon breath not only burned over a thousand undead troops but also directly pierced the 'Dark Shield' cast by the dark mages. Coordinating with Yan Chen's Flame Pivot Barrier to form a 'Flame Dragon Combined Attack', he laid the key foundation for the allied forces to break through the enemy's core camp.
hero.yandi-town.yandiesuleiman.name: Feng Chi
hero.yandi-town.yandiesuleiman.specialty: Yandi creatures have a chance to cast Earthquake after attacking, and gain +2 Speed, +2 damage, and +1 Morale while enchanted.
hero.yandi-town.yandietimur.biography: A lightning magic prodigy of the Yandi tribe, skilled in using thunder energy to fight. His personality is impetuous and brave, making him the core combatant of battle magic. When crossing through time and space, his magical energy was disrupted by the temporal currents, but he unexpectedly awakened a stronger thunder power — the ability to directly summon thunder energy from the sky, which is highly effective against dark creatures and the undead. Upon arriving in Jadam, he used his thunder power to eliminate the magical beasts harassing the tribe, demonstrating his formidable strength. He can cast thunder shields to protect himself and use thunder power to strike enemy forces, earning great merit in many small-scale battles. In the decisive battle, he unleashed the 'Yinglong Path', sending a massive thunderbolt crashing into the enemy camp, not only destroying a large number of undead troops but also paralyzing the main warriors of the Chiyou remnant, creating the perfect opportunity for the allied forces to charge. His lightning magic, combined with Ao Chi's dragon breath, formed the powerful 'Flame-Thunder Combined Attack', terrifying the enemy forces.
hero.yandi-town.yandietimur.name: Huang Zheng
hero.yandi-town.yandietimur.specialty.de: Grants +500 movement points on land and sea, free ship boarding, expert Summon Boat and Scuttle Boat, and whirlpool protection for the hero.
hero.yandi-town.yandieuncleivan.biograph: A covert scout of the Yandi tribe, skilled in stealth, reconnaissance, and assassination. Before crossing through time and space, he was responsible for behind-enemy-lines reconnaissance and intelligence gathering, delivering critical information to the tribe during many crisis moments. Upon arriving in Jadam, he took the initiative to scout the surrounding powers, venturing deep into the Shadow Spiral Mountains to investigate the movements of the undead forces and mapping out the distribution and attitudes of the indigenous tribes. During the confrontation with the Chiyou remnant, he led scout units deep into enemy camps, stealing their battle plans and assassinating several key commanders of the Chiyou remnant, greatly disrupting enemy deployments. His stealth skills were extremely advanced, allowing him to move freely within the sensing range of dark mages and even avoid magical traps. He was the 'hidden agent' of Yandi, providing covert security for the tribe.
hero.yandi-town.yandieuncleivan.name: Li Ze
hero.yandi-town.yandieuncleivan.specialt: The hero may cast three times per combat round. Air spells deal additional damage based on hero level, Yandi creatures are immune to air spell damage, and their attacks cast Lightning Bolt.
hero.yandi-town.yandiexerxes.biography: The prince of the Lionman tribe, a tribe that had been allied with the Yandi tribe for generations and had assisted Yandi in the Battle of Zhuolu. When crossing through time and space, he led the lionman cavalry to guard the rear of the tribe. Attacked by flying magical beasts that emerged from the temporal currents, he used his keen sense of smell and swift speed to slay many beasts, ensuring the safety of the rear. After settling in Jadam, he integrated the riding skills of Jadam's nomadic tribes with the melee advantages of the lionman tribe to form the 'Wind Fang Cavalry Regiment'. He excelled at lightning warfare, leading cavalry units to quickly strike enemy flanks or supply camps. In the decisive battle, he led the Wind Fang Cavalry Regiment in a flanking attack, using the lionmen's biting ability and the cavalry's impact to burn down the enemy's supply camp, directly causing the Chiyou remnant's morale to collapse. He personally slew the cavalry commander of the Chiyou remnant, laying the foundation for the victory.
hero.yandi-town.yandiexerxes.name: Shi Lie
hero.yandi-town.yandiexerxes.specialty.d: Enemy heroes suffer a 15% Spell Power penalty in combat, increasing as the hero gains levels. The hero also regenerates 100 spell points per day.
heroClass.yandi-town.yandiMagic.name: Kui Shaman
heroClass.yandi-town.yandiMight.name: Kui Guard
